sum: Lakeshore Acquisition III Corp. does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or other similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is based in New York, New York.
